findings.title: A newly created nested runner root is not durably linked component by component

evidence.source: TopicObservationRunner.__init__ calls self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True). Unlike the component-wise _ensure_directory_durable path used by ArtifactStore and LiteratureBase, this branch does not fsync each newly created directory's immediate parent.
evidence.reproduction: A fresh /tmp root/deep/root runner initialized successfully while instrumentation of topic_observation._fsync_directory recorded []. The implementation can therefore return a usable runner after directory links that are not crash-durable, and fsync errors from those missing calls cannot propagate.

findings.repair: Create the runner root from the nearest existing ancestor one component at a time, fsync each immediate parent immediately after mkdir, and propagate every mkdir/fsync failure before exposing initialized storage. Add exact-order and per-parent failure-injection coverage for a genuinely absent multi-component root.

findings.title: Pre-import budget evidence blocks a valid strictly-later PENDING-to-OBSERVED recovery

evidence.source: The pre-import exhausted-budget branch records MANUAL_QUEUE evidence with import_disposition null. Historical status-mismatch handling only permits a budget MANUAL_QUEUE upgrade when import_disposition is PENDING, even though the later budget validator accepts either null or PENDING.
evidence.reproduction: Seed OBS-PRE as restricted PENDING, run zero-budget c0->c1 for input A, then run an OPEN c1->c2 retry for input B with the same logical identity, observation ID, idempotency key, digest, and bytes. Literature advances to OBSERVED with an artifact, but the later run raises 'stored item evidence observation status conflicts with literature' and leaves the transaction journal.

findings.repair: Model pre-import and post-import budget evidence as distinct valid phases. Permit the pre-import historical upgrade only after a strictly later validated cursor-chain batch proves the same observation ID, idempotency key, logical identity, and digest with a verified artifact; reject every other status, identity, digest, or cursor transition.

findings.title: A processed replay fails after its historical PENDING observation has been upgraded

evidence.source: The replay branch builds current evidence through _persisted_observation_for_input. After a later upgrade this is OBSERVED evidence, while PROCESSED_INPUT_REPLAY validation requires the persisted identity/status/artifact fields to equal the original batch evidence, which was PENDING.
evidence.reproduction: Run c0->c1 with restricted PENDING input A, c1->c2 with the same source as observed input B, then c2->c3 replay input A. The operation raises TopicObservationError: processed duplicate evidence does not match prior evidence, and the durable transaction journal remains.

findings.repair: Bind a processed replay to the immutable prior disposition snapshot, or explicitly validate the historical pending snapshot against the strictly later upgrade proof without replacing its fields with current literature state. Ensure the replay transaction can commit and clear its journal.

findings.title: PENDING retries can rewrite valid historical observation evidence

evidence.source: _record permits any replacement sharing logical_identity while the existing record is PENDING. It does not require identical pending evidence or restrict the transition to the narrow PENDING-to-OBSERVED completion.
evidence.reproduction: Record a restricted PENDING OBS-P with a valid digest D, then retry the same ID and logical source as OPEN with no digest. Both calls return PENDING, but the in-memory and persisted record changes to an empty digest and OPEN license, losing the earlier durable evidence.

findings.repair: Reject non-identical PENDING-to-PENDING replacements. Preserve immutable identity, version, timestamp, media type, summary, and digest fields, and allow only a validated monotonic PENDING-to-OBSERVED transition with the required open-license and artifact completion. Add same-process and restart regressions for incomplete and backward-metadata retries.
